bar_ratification.headline_gate: maximum over scored sites of max(h_e,v_e) <= 0.05
bar_ratification.reason: The plan fixes the construct but not the number. Five percent is the largest round threshold below the 5.33 percent lower 95 percent bound of the confirmed 6.34 percent merge-created rim, while the matched no-merge upper 95 percent bound is 0.33 percent. It therefore rejects the known defect with a 15-fold margin over the measured null without selecting on any current M3 candidate output.

normalization.narrow_step: right narrow-plateau median minus left narrow-plateau median in the independently selected input normalization profile
normalization.broad_step: right broad-plateau median minus left broad-plateau median in the independently selected input normalization profile

veil.reduction: maximum of the two signed-side arithmetic means
veil.pooled_mean_role: diagnostic only; it is the retired M152 reduction

edge_width.definition: linearly interpolated first dark-to-bright 10 and 90 percent crossings
edge_width.ratio: output 10-90 width divided by independently selected sharp-source width

rho_edge.window: separable Hann normalized to mean-square one
rho_edge.definition: magnitude of summed complex cross-spectrum divided by the geometric mean of summed powers
rho_edge.role: phase-consistency diagnostic only; the edge-width ratio is the non-compensating blur guard

warp.source: input-derived external landmark fit; no output-derived registration

commissioning.null: identity landmarks with independent coordinate noise must pass and return a nonzero residual
commissioning.degradation: a planted similarity outside at least one geometry limit must fail
commissioning.improvement: an independently fitted inverse on disjoint landmarks must restore the planted arm to all three limits

aggregation.percentile: nearest-rank empirical quantile, one-based rank ceil(q*N), no interpolation
aggregation.capture_weighting: the frozen site manifest is pooled without post-output deletion
aggregation.paired_p99: a_e=max(h_e,v_e); choose the comparator having the lowest nearest-rank pooled p99(a_e), then compare strehl p99(a_e) with that comparator p99(a_e) on the identical sites
aggregation.wilson: one-sided 95 percent upper confidence bound with z=1.6448536269514722
